title: Who Should Know What? Empirical Information Design for Multi-Agent LLM Economies
title_zh: 谁应该知道什么？面向多智能体LLM经济的实证信息设计

paragraphs.en: 实验框架比较LLM经济市场中的信息披露策略，发现透明度影响因模型而异，信息设计需与模型协同优化。 The performance of multi-agent LLM systems depends not only on the capabilities of the underlying models but also on information-sharing policies, which govern what information each agent observes and at what level of detail. But does providing AI agents with more detailed information always improve collective outcomes, or can transparency paradoxically degrade efficiency? To investigate this, we introduce empirical information design, an experimental framework that systematically compares disclosure policies across economic markets populated by LLM agents, while holding interaction rules and models fixed. We evaluate ten frontier LLMs in multi-resource trade, bilateral bargaining, and double auctions, using ground-truth utilities to decouple identified opportunities from realized outcomes. We find that finer information disclosure yields highly model-dependent results. In trade, revealing exact valuations rather than ordinal preference rankings reduces realized gains for GPT-6 Sol (from 98% to 91% of maximum) yet increases them for Claude Sonnet 5 (from 72% to 86%). In bargaining, exact information leads Grok 4.7 to produce less balanced agreements, whereas Claude Opus 5.5 divides gains symmetrically. In double auctions, full disclosure inflates price demands, triggering market breakdown and lowering welfare for Gemini 3.1 Pro (97% to 78%), Claude Opus 5.5 (94% to 64%), and Grok 4.7 (97% to 62%). Overall, these results suggest that model selection and information design must be co-optimized, as LLMs vary in how their strategic responses to information impact system objectives.
paragraphs.zh: 实验框架比较LLM经济市场中的信息披露策略，发现透明度影响因模型而异，信息设计需与模型协同优化。多智能体LLM系统的表现不仅取决于底层模型的能力，还取决于信息共享策略，即规定每个智能体观察哪些信息以及观察粒度的策略。 但是，为AI智能体提供更详细的信息总能改善集体结果吗？还是透明度反而可能悖论式地降低效率？ 为探究这一问题，我们提出经验性信息设计，这是一个实验框架，在保持交互规则和模型固定不变的情况下，系统地比较由LLM智能体构成的经济市场中的信息披露策略。 我们在多资源贸易、双边议价和双向拍卖中评估十个前沿LLM，并利用真实效用值将已识别的机会与最终实现的结果解耦。 我们发现，更精细的信息披露会产生高度依赖模型的结果。 在贸易中，揭示精确估值而非序数偏好排序会降低GPT-6 Sol的实现收益（从最大值的98%降至91%），却会提高Claude Sonnet 5的实现收益（从72%升至86%）。 在议价中，精确信息使Grok 4.7达成的协议更不平衡，而Claude Opus 5.5则对称地分割收益。 在双向拍卖中，完全披露会推高报价，引发市场崩溃并降低福利：Gemini 3.1 Pro（97%降至78%）、Claude Opus 5.5（94%降至64%）和Grok 4.7（97%降至62%）。 总体而言，这些结果表明模型选择与信息设计必须协同优化，因为LLM在针对信息的策略性反应如何影响系统目标方面各不相同。
